candidate_answer: The filter generation module creates context-sensitive filters by encoding the input sentence into a fixed-length vector and generating filters via a deconvolutional layer. The convolution module then uses these filters to adaptively encode the input sentence, enabling adaptation to different sentences because the filters are sample-specific and context-dependent.
reference: The ACNN framework learns context-sensitive filters through two modules: the filter generation module and the adaptive convolution module. The filter generation module produces a set of filters conditioned on the input sentence, while the adaptive convolution module applies the generated filters to an input sentence. The two modules are jointly differentiable, and the overall architecture can be trained in an end-to-end manner.
